description: This file contains helper functions for web page testing in the eShopOnWeb project's functional tests. It provides methods for extracting specific tokens and IDs from HTML input strings using regular expressions.

classes.name: WebPageHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods for extracting tokens and IDs from web page HTML content during functional testing.

methods.name: GetRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Extracts the request verification token value from the provided HTML input string.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Extracts the item ID value from the provided HTML input string.

methods.name: RegexSearch
methods.description: Performs a regex match on input string and returns the last matched value.
